correctness.rationale: Weyl conjugation provides the Gram eigenvalues p|A|². Cyclotomic irreducibility equates prime-order ambiguity vanishing with quartic permutation. The centered finite difference is computed explicitly. For primes 1 mod 4 a power-sum obstruction kills all nonzero quartics; for primes 3 mod 4 at least 11 two further moments force B=D=0 and a noninjective even power. At seven the two power-sums and explicit value lists classify exactly four extra zeros on the coefficient locus, and p≤5 follows from Frobenius/quadratic Gauss sums. Exact standalone exhaustive checks all (c,d,a,b) through p=19 and selected larger primes. No finite enumeration substitutes for the infinite proof.

This theorem classifies exactly when a natural two-parameter quintic–cubic phase family attains this optimal observable subspace at every prime and isolates the entire exceptional low-prime resonance and its four missing Weyl directions.
